snippet.title: The Last Citadel - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Check the Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892090/The_Last_Citadel/

A new teaser trailer for The Last Citadel.  A Roguelite multiplayer shooter created by a solo Dev.
Embark on a journey in a forgotten Citadel at the edge of the world

Follow us on Social Media: 

https://www.reddit.com/r/TheLastCitadel/

http://discord.honestdemon.com/

https://www.twitch.tv/honestdemonofficial
